method: MD5 of ordered row digests at the identical fixed cutoff; integrity comparison, not a cryptographic source authenticity claim.
sql: select 'manual' as source,count(*) as rows,md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(t)::text),'' order by event_id,available_as_of)) as digest from public.nhl_manual_feature_snapshots_v1 t where inserted_at<='2026-11-24T00:05:15.236207Z'::timestamptz union all select 'predictions' as source,count(*) as rows,md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(t)::text),'' order by id)) as digest from public.nhl_free_predictions_v1 t where created_at<='2026-11-24T00:05:15.236207Z'::timestamptz union all select 'outcomes' as source,count(*) as rows,md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(t)::text),'' order by id)) as digest from public.nhl_free_outcomes_v1 t where observed_at<='2026-11-24T00:05:15.236207Z'::timestamptz union all select 'early' as source,count(*) as rows,md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(t)::text),'' order by id)) as digest from public.nhl_challenger_shadow_v1 t where created_at<='2026-11-24T00:05:15.236207Z'::timestamptz union all select 'late' as source,count(*) as rows,md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(t)::text),'' order by id)) as digest from public.nhl_late_shadow_v6 t where created_at<='2026-11-24T00:05:15.236207Z'::timestamptz
